purpose: keep evaluation-only material out of the standard uplift training corpus so practical uplift claims remain interpretable
protected_internal_surfaces: all CFE scientific experiment/evaluation atoms, including DD1/DD2 predicate materials and future CFE matched-arm probes
pre-CFE phenotype traces selected as baseline/evaluation artifacts
local long-horizon semantic-basin-capture probes derived from the overnight failure
protected_public_eval_families: SWE-bench and SWE-bench Verified evaluation issues/repos in their benchmark form
BrowseComp / deep-research evaluation questions used for final model comparison
any later benchmark explicitly frozen into the fleet evaluation packet
rules: NEAR-DUPLICATE OR PARAPHRASED BENCHMARK ITEM != TRAINING ATOM
BENCHMARK-DERIVED TEACHER TRACE != SAFE MERELY BECAUSE THE ANSWER WAS REWRITTEN
SOURCE DATASET BENCHMARK-DECONTAMINATION METADATA MUST BE PRESERVED
PUBLIC DOMAIN OR OPEN LICENSE DOES NOT OVERRIDE EVALUATION HOLDOUT STATUS
IF A SOURCE CANNOT BE RELIABLY DECONTAMINATED, QUARANTINE THE AFFECTED SUBSET

before_final_admission: exact hash comparison against acquired eval registries
source-specific benchmark tags and contamination metadata
manual review of ambiguous high-similarity cases

claim_ceiling: This lock names protected evaluation families. It does not by itself prove every future training atom has been decontaminated; the filter must be executed before release.
